headlines.title: Stocks and bonds rally after Fed hikes rates and oil prices fall
headlines.description: U.S. stock indexes rose sharply Thursday after the Federal Reserve hiked interest rates in a bid to rein in rising inflation.

headlines.title: ‘Godfather of AI’ warns Congress has ‘maybe a year’ left to regulate AI
headlines.description: Geoffrey Hinton, known as the “Godfather of AI,” issued an ominous warning: Congress may only have one year left to implement safeguards on artificial intelligence before it loses control of it.

headlines.title: Why Networking is the Essential Career Tool
headlines.description: Networking can open doors and create opportunities, so LinkedIn editor-in-chief Dan Roth stops by TODAY with the keys to doing it effectively and making authentic connections. He shares tips on how to find your network, shares conversation starters when meeting someone new, explains how to make outreach personal and specific and more.

headlines.title: Trump Sounds Off on Fed’s Decision on Interest Rate
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in years amid soaring consumer prices and against the wishes of President Donald Trump. “The board is very hostile. They’re very political. They’re doing the wrong thing,” he said. It comes as the president traveled to battleground North Carolina in an effort to help Republicans maintain control of Congress. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: What Does the Interest Rate Hike Mean for American Consumers?
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 on Wednesday in a move aimed at slowing inflation. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY to break down how the 0.25% hike will impact credit cards, mortgages and the cost of food and gas.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve Poised to Raise Interest Rates: What to Know
headlines.description: With inflation and consumer prices on the rise, Wednesday’s meeting of the Federal Reserve is being closely watched to see what the board will signal about interest rates, now and into the future. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY to break down how the Fed is expected to raise interest rates for the first time since 2023 and for the first time under newly minted chairman Kevin Warsh.

headlines.title: House passes bill to shield consumers from data center price hikes on energy
headlines.description: Unpopular AI data centers proliferating across America have emerged as a major campaign issue in the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Fed raises interest rates for first time since 2023, defying Trump as inflation mounts
headlines.description: The move comes after years of demands from the president for lower rates and could be the start of additional increases.

headlines.title: How Kraft Heinz is keeping its legacy brands affordable to cost-conscious shoppers
headlines.description: For Kraft Heinz CEO Steve Cahillane, changes in the grocery marketplace demand a shift in strategy.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Stocks slip, but traders largely shake off warnings that AI industry should slow down
headlines.description: A rally in software and cybersecurity stocks propelled indexes off their worst levels of the day.

headlines.title: 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% as oil surges and diesel hits all-time high
headlines.description: Talks between Iran and Gulf countries about the future of the Strait of Hormuz were delayed after a key Saudi pipeline was hit.
